name: Sunk Cost Fallacy
axiom: Money already spent pulls the next decision, though only future costs should.
trigger: A team keeps funding a feature because of what it has already cost.
checklist: Name the cost already spent and leave it out of the go/no-go calculation.
Judge the next step by what it costs from here and what it returns.
Rewrite a stuck decision as if nothing had been spent yet, then compare.

antiPattern.violation: A failing feature keeps its budget because half of it is already built.
antiPattern.remediation: Decide on the remaining cost and return; note the spent money and exclude it.

parametricParams.caption: WHAT IS SPENT SHOULD NOT STEER WHAT COMES NEXT

academicOrigin.title: The psychology of sunk cost
academicOrigin.publication: Organizational Behavior and Human Decision Processes, 35(1), 124-140
